items.title: Annotate toolbar integrity
items.summary: All key buttons are present on markdown, HTML, and live-site targets. Recorded on the HTML target; the other two were checked by DOM assertion.

findings.text: Button set is unchanged from v0.17.5: comment, thumbs up, quick tags, submit.
Quick-tags popover opens 40ms slower on the live-site target than on markdown; within budget.

checkpoints.label: Page loads
checkpoints.narration: article.html opens through the local server; no console errors.

checkpoints.label: Toolbar renders
checkpoints.narration: All four key buttons present: comment, thumbs up, quick tags, submit.

checkpoints.label: Comment added
checkpoints.narration: Selecting paragraph 2 and commenting produces the highlight and a stored annotation.

checkpoints.label: Quick tag applied
checkpoints.narration: needs-work tag attaches to the annotation; the chip renders.

checkpoints.label: Feedback submitted
checkpoints.narration: Submit succeeds; the payload contains both the comment and the tag.
